_comment: One statistics vocabulary for one paper. Copy into the project, edit the values that differ, and point stats_lint.py at it with --vocab. Defaults are the author's.
declaration_pattern: (?i)p values? (?:at or )?(?:below|under|of at most|≤|<=) ?[.0-9]+ (?:are|is) printed|printed only (?:when|if|for) .{0,40}p

banned.use: error bars, and say what they show (25th to 75th percentile)
significant / no significant change (adjusted p); 'minimum detectable effect', 'smallest detectable difference' and 'detectable effect size' are allowed as power-planning terms
not significant (adjusted p = ...), with the effect size
name the object: interquartile range over N bootstrap draws, or 95% confidence interval
adjust every p in the family, or state plainly why one is outside it
a plain sentence saying when and why the item was added
state what was measured and its size
state which comparisons are significant, with the count and denominator
no special-case markers; put the item in the family or give a plain reason
the spread between replicate seeds, defined where it is used

warn.use: a measured relation: ranks below, is rated above ... by Elo, X against Y
ranks first by [measure]; a sentence the author wrote with leads and a named measure stays
first, if first holds on the stated measure
no significant change, unless invariance is the technical property
say what was varied: 'change in score by input transformation'
on figures and in prose for readers: 'the result over the N tasks together'
fine in Methods; on a figure say what was fixed in advance
not significant (adjusted p = ...), with the effect size (Suggested, not yet tested in real work)
